description: Transaction receipt on Scroll (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use scroll_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x0176fb42be8ea0058d1ac56cb253f0df883ba4b564489e71b83fb7e27e912abd. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: scroll_receipt
title: Scroll transaction receipt
